name: OpenVibe.Today

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else

drains: the outbox publisher and the reminder and brief jobs stopped

resumes.what: today_outbox rows not yet published are sent again under their fixed evt_ ids (Events keeps one per id)
reminders due while it was down are sent on the first pass (claimed by UPDATE … WHERE sent_at IS NULL, never twice); the brief job builds a missing day
OpenVibe.Events redelivers live.stream.* and the account events pending during the stop; today_processed applies each once

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates Today's own tables; an earlier release has none to read

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site

notes: Port 5100, unit openvibe-today.service, PostgreSQL database ov_today. The Today room (plan 2026-10-28 §5.3): the network's time bus and calendar authority. v1 owns schedules (streams and events), reminders (sent as Network notifications through network.notifications.push), calendar feeds (RFC 5545: a channel's public feed and a person's private one) and the daily brief. It publishes today.event.* from an outbox and moves a stream live and ended from live.stream.started / ended. OAuth client `today` (sign-in), Network follows for the agenda.

site.name: Today
site.what: Stream schedules, reminders that find you on any OpenVibe site, calendar feeds for your own calendar app, and a morning brief, all in one place.
